guarantees.claim: When sel_mux is not one of MuxFifo, MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd, keccak_valid_o is driven to 0.
guarantees.cond: sel_mux not in {MuxFifo, MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd}

guarantees.claim: When sel_mux equals MuxFifo, keccak_valid_o equals msg_valid_i AND (NOT hold_msg) AND (NOT en_msgbuf).
When sel_mux equals MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad or MuxZeroEnd, keccak_valid_o is driven by fsm_keccak_valid.

assumptions.claim: In MuxFifo mode, hold_msg and en_msgbuf must not be simultaneously asserted with msg_valid_i when a valid data beat should be forwarded to keccak.
assumptions.cond: sel_mux == MuxFifo and valid data ready
assumptions.risk: keccak_valid_o is forced low, causing the data beat to be missed by downstream Keccak.

assumptions.claim: When sel_mux selects MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad or MuxZeroEnd, fsm_keccak_valid is asserted only when a complete and valid keccak block is ready.
assumptions.risk: Spurious assertion of keccak_valid_o may feed garbage or incomplete block to Keccak.

uncertain_points.claim: The ~en_msgbuf condition in MuxFifo case suppresses keccak_valid_o when en_msgbuf is high. The intended behavior of en_msgbuf is not locally clear: if en_msgbuf stays high, all valid handshakes are blocked, potentially losing data or stalling indefinitely.
uncertain_points.risk: Data loss or pipeline deadlock if en_msgbuf is not correctly deasserted during valid message beats.

uncertain_points.claim: hold_msg can deassert keccak_valid_o in MuxFifo mode; the generation of hold_msg is outside this chunk. If hold_msg is stuck high, keccak_valid_o will remain low, causing deadlock.
uncertain_points.cond: sel_mux == MuxFifo and hold_msg stuck high
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream Keccak never receives valid data, stalling the pipeline.

uncertain_points.claim: Because keccak_valid_o is combinational, a transition of sel_mux while source signals (msg_valid_i, hold_msg, en_msgbuf, fsm_keccak_valid) are changing can cause a glitch on keccak_valid_o. This may violate Keccak's handshake protocol if it expects a stable valid.
uncertain_points.cond: sel_mux changing near edges of source signals
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious acceptance of a keccak block or protocol violation.
